verdict.rationale: Maritime documents sleep/wake behavior and automatic waking of sleeping agents, but no evidence gives a cold-start or wake latency figure. The 'under 5 minutes' claim covers first deployment, not sandbox start time. The always-on add-on for agents that 'must react in milliseconds' suggests sleeping agents do not wake that fast, but no number is documented either way.

support.subject: As a developer, I can start sandboxes with documented sub-second-to-few-second cold starts
